name: bespunky-communication
description: How Claude speaks: ships the 'Pitch to the listener' output style, every answer pitched to the person reading it. Brief by default, for a reader who stepped out; full depth the moment they engage. One question per message, placed last; short reports of finished work that never drop a caveat; structure only where it earns its place; no unexplained jargon or bare verdicts. Presentation only. Default in BeSpunky projects; elsewhere pick it with /output-style.
